snippet.title: Heart of the Mountain - The Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim Creation
snippet.description:
Find Heart of the Mountain here: https://creations.bethesda.net/en/skyrim/details/0e5f8707-4376-4dd7-a4b0-0d5f311829d0/Heart_of_the_Mountain 

Available on #xbox  and #pcgaming 

Venture into the Old Lands, a vast new world that hosts multiple new biomes, including a scorching desert, mist-shrouded swamp, and a haunted forest, in this story-focused, fully-voiced Creation for the Elder Scrolls V: #skyrim ! Explore over 40 new full-size dungeons, including Ayleid Ruins, dro-m’Athra temples, Argonian xanmeers, and more.

Team up with Audrey, a mysterious living doll, as you unravel the mysteries of the Void and learn the truth of the Old Lands. Take on almost 70 unique quests and 20 Radiant quests as you explore the Old Lands, and gain new weapons and gear sets, including the new Voskrona armor! In this new land, you will encounter new enemies and summonable creatures from the depths of the Void, such as Harrowing Reapers and Voidmothers, ancient Argonian foes such as Voriplasms and Voskrona, and many more.
